LanguageData.SW_AcidSpew.label: acid spew
LanguageData.SW_AcidSpew.description: Spray offensive stomach acid all over the target area. The acid will stick to targets and burn them.
LanguageData.SW_Calamity.label: calamity
LanguageData.SW_Calamity.description: Release a powerful roar which has a chance to cause hostile humans and animals to tremble in fear, reducing their movement speed and manipulation; usually resulting in calamity on the battlefield.
LanguageData.SW_ForceChaosSkip.label: force chaos skip
LanguageData.SW_ForceChaosSkip.description: This creature can access a Force dimension to teleport a target to a random position near where it started. Objects above a certain size cannot be teleported.
LanguageData.SW_ForceFocus.label: force focus
LanguageData.SW_ForceFocus.description: The creatures can use it's instinctual pack mentality and innate connection with the Force to strengthen theirs or anothers senses. This state lasts for 3 hours.
LanguageData.SW_ForceInvisibility.label: force invisibility
LanguageData.SW_ForceInvisibility.description: This creature can use the force to manipulate the visual centers of everyone nearby, rendering them unable to perceived for a short time.
LanguageData.SW_ForcePush.label: force push blast
LanguageData.SW_ForcePush.description: Use the creatures innate force connection to send a blast of force energy, damaging and stunning a target.
LanguageData.SW_ForceScream.label: force scream
LanguageData.SW_ForceScream.description: Release a powerful force amplified scream which has a chance to cause hostile humans and animals to tremble in fear, reducing their movement speed and manipulation.
LanguageData.SW_GoldForage.label: gold forage
LanguageData.SW_GoldForage.description: This creature has a unique ability to sniff out small quanities of precious gold that have usually been left behind by deep drilling.
LanguageData.SW_Leap.label: animal leap
LanguageData.SW_Leap.description: Jump to a distant location using strong hind legs.
LanguageData.SW_Leap.verbProperties.label: leap
LanguageData.SW_Rampage.label: rampage
LanguageData.SW_Rampage.description: The creatures goes into a heightened physical state fueled by adrenaline. This strengthens them past normal limits but makes them go manhunter and will attack anyone. This state will last for 3 hours.
LanguageData.SW_SootheSong.label: soothing song
LanguageData.SW_SootheSong.description: Release a calming song which can boost the mood nearby humans.
LanguageData.SW_Spit.label: spit
LanguageData.SW_Spit.description: Make the creature launch a glob of icky spit, stunning a target. Disgusting.
LanguageData.SW_Spur.label: spur
LanguageData.SW_Spur.description: The creatures goes into a heightened physical state fueled by adrenaline. This makes them faster for approximately 3 hours.
LanguageData.SW_SwarmCall.label: swarm call
LanguageData.SW_SwarmCall.description: This creature can cause nearby animal to temporarily turn manhunter by directing a subsonic Force imbued screech at them. This mental state will last for 3 hours.
LanguageData.SW_ToxicSpew.label: defensive vomiting
LanguageData.SW_ToxicSpew.description: Launch the contents of a creatures toxic stomach cavity. Upon impact, the vomit will combust and release tox gas for several seconds.
LanguageData.SW_WebShot.label: web shot
LanguageData.SW_WebShot.description: Use the creatures spinneret to launch a blob of hardened webbing, damaging and stunning a target.
